name: Law Enforcement
description: Police officers and detectives sworn to uphold the law.

bonusFeatChoices.name: Point Blank Shot
bonusFeatChoices.description: Benefit: The character gets a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with ranged weapons against opponents within 30 feet.

bonusFeatChoices.name: Personal Firearms Proficiency
bonusFeatChoices.description:
Benefit: The character can fire any personal firearm without penalty.
Normal: Characters without this feat take a –4 penalty on attack rolls made with personal firearms.
